title: Add an explicit frame-to-Observation mapping
finding: The profile correctly extends D01.02 but does not give a complete mapping to the class fields. Do not require all data-object fields at L0.
proposed_followup: Add a reviewed mapping appendix using C01 through C24.

title: Enforce precision information and define value constraints
finding: Audio without sample_format and bit_depth is accepted. Zero sample rate/channel count and negative index are also accepted. Explicit range rules need agreement.
proposed_followup: Implement profile validation. Keep alternatives/conditional bit-depth rules explicit.

title: Specify compact metadata preservation on raw references
finding: The storage branch removes nine direct metadata fields. They remain in stored JSON, so this is a resolution/preservation gap rather than permanent data loss.
proposed_followup: Keep decoding/gating metadata alongside references or define and implement mandatory resolution before consumption.

title: Reject conflicting frame and payload declarations
finding: Payload merge can change encoding, modality, or producer identity from the outer frame. The contract allows two locations but gives no conflict rule.
proposed_followup: Specify one authoritative representation. Reject disagreements rather than silently override.

category: Conditional contract clarification and enforcement gap
title: Make gating activation and threshold units explicit
finding: Conditional required fields need a policy context. The wording mixes dBFS thresholds and noise-floor offsets. Incomplete gate metadata passed under the enabled-gating assumption.
proposed_followup: Define activation/configuration reference, field types, absolute thresholds versus offsets, and conditional checks.

title: Define and enforce stream/session ordering and resets
finding: One source emitted frame indices 2 then 1 through L1. The audio profile does not precisely separate source-session/reset scope from SAR processing sessions.
proposed_followup: Specify monotonicity, duplicates, replay, and reset handling. Any producer epoch remains a proposal until approved.

title: Clarify generated versus native frame identity
finding: Native identity and derived object IDs work in the positive case. Generated fallback IDs collide across streams, and estimated fields lack origin markers.
proposed_followup: Preserve native IDs, assign independent object IDs, define fallback scope, and approve generated-field provenance.

title: Resolve run/session propagation without assuming a new field exists
finding: The observed L1/O1 records lack run/session IDs. Issue 23 associated ExecutionContext is still a design proposal, not an implemented class field.
proposed_followup: Approve a representation and propagation boundary through T03/T17.

title: Require retention, discard, and segment evidence before acceptance
finding: No live gating processor, ring buffer, deletion workflow, or multi-frame phrase extractor was exercised. Permitted features are not treated as universally mandatory.
proposed_followup: Test the selected policy modes and every enabled conditional behavior, preserving required audit traces.

title: Review mutable metadata ownership separately
finding: L2 shares the incoming TimeContext object. Issue 23 recommends isolating mutable metadata, but an approved immutability/copy policy has not been established.
proposed_followup: Decide ownership/copy semantics before treating this behavior as a class-contract violation.
